title: DeSTSeg: Segmentation Guided Denoising Student-Teacher for Anomaly Detection
mechanism: Frozen teacher, denoising student trained to map corrupted normals to clean teacher features, and a segmentation head that fuses multi-level teacher-student discrepancies under synthetic-mask supervision.
adaptation: Teacher = ImageNet ResNet-34 (house encoder init); student trained on clean pool cells corrupted with dark Gaussian-profile lines (FWHM 3-5 px, 2-20% contrast) and dark blobs; seg head supervised by real crack + inactive labels (478 cells) plus synthetic masks; output a 2-class map as 6th ensemble member on crack / inactive logits.
evidence: R: MVTec AD image AUC 98.6, pixel AP 75.8, instance AP 76.4.
min_experiment: Arm: 5 PF seeds + DeSTSeg-EL member; baseline: 5 PF seeds. Metric: CV relR@2 at relP@2 >= 0.90, inactive IoU. Kill: relR@2 gain < +0.02.
prior_overlap: none; 5-seed ensembling is closed as a win but a heterogeneous AD member is listed as untested.
